The **Gauss Shotgun** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

A powerful shotgun with damage superior to other firearms in its class. Like the Gauss Rifle, the Gauss Shotgun can be charged to increase the damage of fired rounds.

Although the Gauss Shotgun is listed under "energy guns" when crafted, Gauss Shotguns do not count as energy weapons like other Gauss weapons. As with other *Wastelanders* weapons only available with Gold Bullion, Gauss Shotguns cannot be traded or dropped.
